headline: Russia Launches Massive Missile-Drone Attack on Kyiv
subheadline: Three ballistic missiles strike Kyiv's northern bridge and Epicentr mall; nationwide Shahed/Geran-5 drone wave hits ten Ukrainian oblasts overnight per monitors.
lede: Russia launched a massive combined ballistic missile and drone strike against Kyiv and at least ten Ukrainian oblasts overnight, with three ballistic missiles hitting the capital region including the northern bridge and the Epicentr mall in Obolon. Ukrainian air defenses engaged Shahed/Geran-5 drones across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, and Dnipropetrovsk regions while ballistic missile threats persisted from Kursk and Voronezh directions. Simultaneously, Iran fired two missiles from its 15 Khordad Base in Isfahan and threatened strikes on U.S. bases in Europe, as American tanker deployments surged to 203 aircraft — the highest level since June. Israeli forces continued intensive operations in southern Lebanon with nine airstrikes and twenty artillery strikes on November 11, while Baghdad ordered an investigation into fuel theft at a key IRGC-backed militia stronghold.

sections.title: Russia Launches Massive Missile-Drone Attack on Kyiv
sections.body: Three ballistic missiles struck the Kyiv region overnight: two likely KN-23 missiles impacted near Kaharlyk and Bila Tserkva, while an Iskander-M hit near Irpin, Bucha, and Kyiv proper. Three impacts were reported on Kyiv's northern bridge and a strike hit the Epicentr shopping mall in the Obolon district. A nationwide wave of Shahed/Geran-5 drones targeted at least ten oblasts including Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Kirovohrad, and Dnipropetrovsk. Ballistic missile threats remained active from Kursk and Voronezh directions, and Russian ground forces advanced near Kostyantynivka and Chervone in Donetsk oblast as ceasefire talks stalled with Moscow rejecting Kyiv's proposal.

sections.title: Iran Fires Missiles, Threatens US Bases in Europe
sections.body: Iran launched two missiles from the 15 Khordad Base in Isfahan at 15:40 local time, while SNSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei warned of strikes on U.S. bases in Europe and new locations if attacked, asserting enriched uranium remains in Iran and claiming advanced electronic warfare capabilities. U.S. CENTCOM maintains a naval blockade on Iran to block IRGC smuggling via land and Caspian Sea routes while keeping the Strait of Hormuz open. American tanker deployments reached 203 KC-135R/T and KC-46A aircraft across Europe and CENTCOM bases, the highest level since June, indicating sustained air operations capacity. Israeli forces conducted airstrikes on nine locations and artillery shelling on twenty sites across southern Lebanon on November 11, and Iraqi Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered a probe into fuel siphoning at Jurf al-Sakhar, a major IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah stronghold south of Baghdad.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The convergence of Russia's largest combined ballistic missile and drone barrage on Kyiv in months with Iran's demonstrated missile launch and explicit threats against U.S. bases in Europe signals coordinated escalation across two major theaters. The U.S. tanker buildup to 203 aircraft and naval blockade of Iran indicate preparation for sustained air operations, while Israeli multi-front strikes in Lebanon and Iraqi scrutiny of IRGC logistics create additional friction points. The simultaneous ballistic missile threats from Kursk and Voronezh, Iranian missile readiness at Isfahan, and stalled ceasefire talks in Ukraine collectively raise the probability of miscalculation or deliberate escalation in the coming weeks.
